My current spammor config is:

"""

  image: ethpandaops/spamoor:master
  max_mem: 4000
  spammers:
    - scenario: eoatx
      config:
        throughput: 200
    - scenario: blobs
      config:
        throughput: 20
"""

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
```
spamoor_params:
  image: ethpandaops/spamoor:master
  spammers:
    - scenario: eoatx
      config:
        throughput: 100
        client_group: prysm-geth-1
```
